claims.claim: All four clinicians on one screen, in the same order, with their rooms. 15-minute rows, "Last, First" names and Day/Week/Month.
claims.evidence: render/schedule.png: Rao, Feld, Kim, Ortega with 'Rm 1–3', 'Rm 4–5', 'Rm 6', 'Rm 7'; 15-minute rows; 'Brennan, Harold' names; Day | Week | Month segmented control. render.json: no horizontal overflow.

claims.claim: All twelve appointment actions in the right panel.
claims.evidence: render/schedule.png: the right panel shows 11 action controls (Collect copay, Room, Check out, Reschedule, Edit, Reminder, Eligibility, Notes, Print, No-show, Cancel appt).
